takesPerTemplate: Uses the same first-take numbers as tests/piano-engine-production.test.ts, then the next two takes. For a uniform 40-bar comparison, this report uses three-chorus-40bars.json for all five templates; the production regression uses dorian-16bars.json for Sonata.
exportTrack: Piano on channel 16; UVI Grand Model D; no keyswitch or transposition; CC64 enabled
serializationNote: The repo-local midi-file dependency is absent. buildPerTrackMidi and parseMidiFile were exercised through a temporary minimal SMF compatibility shim; the 15 generated files were round-tripped against chunksForTrack note and CC64 events. This does not replace the official midi-file-backed test.
targetedCorrection: Fresh comparison found that full-span Composer leave-space decisions still carried planned motif cells even though the Realizer suppresses attacks there. The Composer now emits no motif cells/syncopation when an explicit leave-space decision covers the full phrase, with a regression test in tests/piano-engine-v5.test.ts. This did not add notes. It removed phantom release motifs from the cross-phrase melodic pitch state: in Chamber take 1, the first note at tick 107520 of the following reprise changed from pitch 64/duration 3533 to pitch 76/duration 2508; other 14 sampled note hashes matched the pre-correction exports. The CC64 lanes match exactly across all 15 pre/post comparisons. This single consequential note change is not an audio-quality verdict.
